description: Daily margin-trading (融资融券) series for one A-share: financing balance / gross buy / repayment / net buy, short-sell and short balance (shares and CNY), total balance, day-over-day change. **T+1 — the latest row is normally the previous trading day** (in backtests visible_date = trade_date + 1). ⚠️ `financing_buy_cny` is GROSS (includes round-trips) — judge direction by `financing_net_buy_cny` only; short side likewise by the change in `short_balance_shares`. ⚠️ `null` = not published / not derivable (Shenzhen and Beijing publish no repayment), not zero. ⚠️ `financing_balance_chg_*` is versus `prev_trade_date` — check it is adjacent.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

days.description: Look-back window in calendar days (1-250, default 60). Ignored when from/to given.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `to`.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `from`.

name: margin_show
